source_title: Manchester City v Paris Saint-Germain: Women’s Champions League – live
source_excerpt:
Tara Elimbi Gilbert scores late to cancel out Bunny Shaw’s penalty
3d ago Full time: Man City 1-1 Paris Saint-Germain
3d ago GOAL! Man City 1-1 Paris Saint-Germain (Elimbi Gilbert 88)
3d ago PENALTY! Man City 1-0 Paris Saint-Germain (Shaw 85)
3d ago Back underway: Man City 0-0 Paris Saint-Germain
3d ago Half-time: Man City 0-0 Paris Saint-Germain
3d ago Full time: Man City 1-1 Paris Saint-Germain
3d ago GOAL! Man City 1-1 Paris Saint-Germain (Elimbi Gilbert 88)
3d ago PENALTY! Man City 1-0 Paris Saint-Germain (Shaw 85)
3d ago Back underway: Man City 0-0 Paris Saint-Germain
3d ago Half-time: Man City 0-0 Paris Saint-Germain
Thank you so much for joining me for this game . Man City thought they had all three points in the bag when Shaw scored a penalty but Elimbi Gilbert’s introduction and subsequent goal meant they shared the spoils. Have a read of the report below to catch up with all of the action and we’ll see you soon.
Former Manchester City captain Steph Houghton told BBC Two on if her ex-club needed to win today:
double quotation mark I think from a confidence point of view yes. I think to go into the next game with five points would have obviously been more beneficial but I think in general the group will be really disappointed with the way that they concede.
I think when you get to 84 minutes, your top scorer puts a penalty away, you’ve played well in the second half, probably created more than PSG. PSG will be more happy with a point.
I still think we are in control of our own fate. Win those three games and you qualify.
That is three draws from three Champions League games for City now which means they are 10th in the table. PSG are sixth with two draws and a win.
In the other 8pm GMT kick-off, Barcelona have thumped HB Køge 8-0! A huge statement from the defending champions.
What an ending to this game . It looked like a nailed on conclusion that Man City were going to come away with the win after Shaw scored a penalty but Elimbi Gilbert caught City napping to share the points. This will be hugely disappointing to City who conceded a late equaliser against United last weekend.
90 + 3 min : Kanjinga tries to find a winner for the visitors but the flag was up.
90 + 2 min : City are really pressing here, PSG are just booting the ball absolutely anywhere away from goal to rescue a point away from home.
90 + 1 min : There will be four minutes added.
90 min : They do say you are your most vulnerable just after you score and my word that was impressive. A huge blow for City.
The PSG sub makes an incredible run and she just keeps going, slotting it into the bottom corner. That was too easy.
87 min : PSG will struggle to find a response here I think, they haven’t had a clear attacking chance for the last 10 minutes. But you never know, it may happen.
It wasn’t a bad effort from Peda to try and save that, I think she got a fingertip to it but Shaw’s effort was just too powerful.
VAR did check if Shaw was offside in the build-up to the foul but she wasn’t. The Jamaica international had the chance to convert the opportunity herself and she slots it.
84 min : City have been awarded a penalty as Shaw was caught by Mbock in the box. Wow, what an error from the French defender.
83 min : City’s latest chance was on target from Fowler but it wasn’t powerful enough to trouble Peda.
82 min : Mbock is down and back up quickly after contact with Hemp in City’s box and so PSG can clear.
80 min : PSG have to defend with 10 as City take the free kick but it’s easily cleared by the visitors. City do have another chance through Shaw but it’s over the bar. Confirmation that Karchaoui is being replaced by Gilbert.
78 min : Karchaoui really screamed in pain after that clash, hopefully it isn’t anything too serious. She is shaking her head as she walks off of the pitch, it hasn’t been confirmed but I don’t believe she will continue.
76 min : Groenen fouls Fujino and City have a free kick on half way. The hosts build from deep and eventually Groenen gives away another foul. Karchaoui has an extended period on the pitch after fouling Charles, she needs some treatment.
74 min : The City subs really did add another level to their game but that seems to have ebbed away now after those two Shaw chances were snuffed out. While it hasn’t always been pretty, the PSG defence deserves its plaudits tonight.
72 min : Both sides have chances that are missed, City have been the better side this game but they will share the spoils as things stand.
70 min : How has Shaw not scored there? That’s an unlucky bounce of the ball. Hemp delivered a peach of a ball and Shaw heads it, it' bounces on the pitch and out.
68 min : The corner is well taken and Fowler gets a chance but it’s blocked, the PSG defence are having everything thrown at them right now. It looked as though they had finally got their goal but Shaw is ruled offside.
67 min : Wow what a save from Peda. City find Shaw in some space, she takes a touch and launches a shot from outside of the area and the keeper does enough to push it wide. A corner to come.
66 min : City are putting more pace into their game but Groenen does well to marshal the ball to Peda. The former Manchester United player looks uncomfortable afterwards, grabbing her face but she is okay to continue. PSG makes their first change with Morissaint off for Kanjinga.
64 min : Charles makes an immediate impact with a cross popped into the box but the chance goes begging.
62 min : The longer this match goes on, the more it feels like neither side are going to score. Or I will be very wrong and the game will open up into a goal fest. City makes three subs with Clinton, Casparji and Knaak for Beney, Charles and Fowler.
60 min : Karchaoui makes a great run but she is fouled by Greenwood, who receives a yellow card for the foul. The set piece is in a good spot and Karchaoui takes it. It’s lifted over the wall but it’s just over the top corner.
58 min : Hemp and Greenwood connect beautifully down the left and Hemp gets a perfectly timed cross in but Samoura again defends well as Fujino tried to get a shot on target but failed.
56 min : The pace of this game hasn’t slowed as such but it feels a bit more scrappy. Some bright moments for both teams but nothing is sticking.
54 min : End-to-end football ensues but fans are yet to see a meaninful chance.
52 min : The corner ball comes in but Shaw is shoved to the floor, nothing is given. Knaak makes contact with the ball but her header is wide.
51 min : Shaw was so close to closing down Samoura in the box but PSG somehow manage to organise a scramble defence, it ends with City being awarded another corner.
50 min : Here come City again but Osteras deflects the ball out of play for a corner. The delivery from Casparji is short but it eventually comes in and Shaw sees it out for a goal kick.
48 min : This half is very much the same story as the first: City in control but PSG growing.
46 min : There are no changes for either side at half-time. City look to get this half off to a quick start with Fujino having a chance which goes wide.
Will we see a winner in this second half? All to come.
In the other 8pm GMT kick-off, Barcelona are beating Køge 2-0.
Well, City will be wondering how they didn’t score in the opening 25 minutes. Hemp has been incredible but they are yet to find a way through. PSG are growing into this and they will look to break the deadlock in the second 45.
45 + 4 min : Carmona gives away a corner late on in the first half and it’s popped in. It’s headed goalward but Peda saves.
45 + 3 min : There is a slight delay to half-time as Samoura is receiving some treatment for a stray elbow. She looks okay to continue.
45 + 1 min : There will be one minute added.
44 min : Greenwood takes the corner and the deliver, again, is very good but no one is found in the box and it’s out for a goal kick.
43 min : Hemp makes a great run as she tries to spark something towards the end of this half, she attempts a cross but Samoura blocks it for a corner.
42 min : A lot of the game now being played in the midfield, if City don’t find a break through they will be frustrated at half-time.
